name: bds_grow_order
description: Test 6, from 4.4 and 4.14; the draws were recomputed with an independent Python model of the cRZRandom LCG (NextRaw for seed 12345: 0x0C63D3DC, 0xFED6A704, 0x6E80D665; for seed 1: 0x000041C6, 0x59D4967E, 0xBF022781). Bias 10; active demand 0x1010 100, 0x1020 3 (not > 5: excluded), 0x3110 40, 0x4300 250. Seed 12345: RandomUint32Uniform(420) = 20 < 110 -> 0x1010; (310) = 308 -> 308 - 50 = 258 < 260 -> 0x4300; (50) = 21 -> 0x3110. Tract-developer Grow calls 0x1010 (1, 1), 0x4300 (4, 4), 0x3110 (3, 3), each with the item's stage, an empty outcome list and flag false; 0x1020 gets none. Then only 0x1020 is pending: RandomUint32Uniform(0) is called, does not step, picks nobody, and Grow returns ([choice] work budget: grow_budget is set to u32::MAX here, so the day ends when every qualifying developer has had its attempt; no timer, no spin). Exactly 3 generator steps. Seed 1 (a fresh process and BDS): draws 0 of 420, 108 of 310, 37 of 50, the same order. Built 0 everywhere, so lastSuccessfulBuild stays at the Init day.
